en: I'm Not Lying But I'm Beautifying
ov: أنا لا أكذب ولكني أتجمل هو فيلم مصري من إنتاج عام 1981، عن قصة للكاتب إحسان عبد القدوس وإخراج إبراهيم الشقنقيري من بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار وأحمد زكي وآثار الحكيم.
plotEn: Rafik Hamdy is a famous writer, who has one daughter, Khairya, a college student. Her colleague Ibrahim, the diligent student, falls in love with her and she also exchanges love, although the rich student Hani admires her, Ibrahim tries to hide the truth of his social level for fear that Khairiya will move away from him, to claim that he is from a wealthy family. But eventually, Rafik knows the truth and confronts Ibrahim and now Khairia must choose.

wiki.en: I'm Not Lying But I'm Beautifying
